# db-migration

Plans and makes database migrations through the project's migration tool (shipped for Prisma). Use when asked to "plan a migration", "add a field to the Prisma schema", "rename this column", or "check this migration", when changing a database schema, migrating a model, field, enum, or relation, or creating, fixing, or auditing a migration. Not for general questions about ORMs or comparing tools.

| | |
|---|---|
| Who starts it | You or the agent. You can ask for it by name (`/shipyard-delivery:db-migration` in Claude Code); the agent also starts it when the request matches the description. |
| Arguments | none |
| Allowed tools | Read, Glob, Grep |
| Project settings | `.claude/shipyard/db-migration.md`, `.claude/shipyard/prisma-workflow.md` |
| Settings fields | [overlay-example.md](../../plugins/shipyard-delivery/skills/db-migration/references/overlay-example.md) |
